Hi @eng-68, yes the check is intentional per the design review notes. The quantity string should represent a positive amount (e.g., '2 CS' for shipment), and the sign is applied based on movement type (SHP makes it negative). Negative quantities in the input string are only valid for ADJ records. The acceptance test test_quantity_sign_rules explicitly validates this behavior.
